title: Adapter operation: collect v1
description: 00 §10 protocol operation 'collect' (04.7.1-T1.2). Direction: adapter → server — the artifact inventory collected from the allowed workspace directory, reported as the shared 00 §9.4 event envelope whose artifact_ids carry the collected artifacts (source §4: 'artifact inventory, checksum; never reads files outside the workspace'). The envelope schema is referenced by $id (urn:evidgate:contract:event-envelope.v1), never copied. At most 500 events, like the ingest batch (00 §9.3). A failed phase reports `error` instead of the payload: at least one of `events` and `error` is required (contracts/adapter/README.md).
